zh: 如果每一步都前进，位置依次是三角数1、3、6、10……，终点是T=steps·(steps+1)/2，这是能到达的上界。
若禁点不是这些正三角数之一，一直前进即可得到T；若是，至少要少走一点，答案不超过T−1。只跳过第一步时，之后的位置都是三角数减1，而相邻正三角数相差至少2，所以绝不会踩到那个三角数禁点。
禁点为0时起点本身被禁，输出-1；否则检查是否存在1≤j≤steps使j(j+1)/2等于禁点，存在则输出T−1，否则输出T。
en: If you move at every step, the positions are the triangular numbers 1, 3, 6, 10, ..., ending at T=steps·(steps+1)/2, which is the upper bound.

If the forbidden index is not one of these positive triangular numbers, moving every step gives T; if it is, you must give up at least a little, so the answer is at most T−1. Skipping only the first step makes every later position a triangular number minus 1, and distinct positive triangular numbers differ by at least 2, so that forbidden triangular number is never hit.
If the forbidden index is 0 the start itself is forbidden, so print -1; otherwise check whether some 1≤j≤steps has j(j+1)/2 equal to the forbidden index, and print T−1 if so, otherwise T.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Moving at every step ends at the triangular number T; if some positive triangular prefix is the forbidden point, skip the first step and the answer is T−1; otherwise it is T. A forbidden starting point returns -1 separately.

## Proof of correctness

Without skipping, the position after each step is a triangular number, so if the forbidden point is never hit, the upper bound equal to the sum of all step lengths is reached. If it is hit, at least 1 must be given up, giving the upper bound T−1; after skipping the first step, every position after a forward step is a triangular number minus 1, and adjacent positive triangular numbers differ by at least 2, so such a position never equals that positive triangular forbidden point, and the bound is achievable.

## Complexity

Time O(steps), space O(1).
